title: studio(condition builder): "is false / empty" compiles to `!field` and "is true / set" to a bare field — CEL refuses both on a non-boolean field, so a published validation rule blocks every matching write
body:
**Filing gate ① — product defect with a named location and a reproduction.** reach: measured in the Studio task benchmark baseline (objectstack-ai/objectstack#22180, step 4 and 8b): a validation rule built in Studio's condition builder as `record.status` *equals* `done` AND `record.due_date` *is false / empty* saved and published as `record.status == 'done' && !record.due_date` (publish 200); afterwards every Done write was refused — `PATCH /api/v1/data/repair_ticket/{id}` → `400 VALIDATION_FAILED`, reason unevaluable, fault `runtime: no such overload: !null` (no due date) or `!string` (with one) — shown to the end user as a red toast. Reproduced three times (two forged requests, one end-user UI save).

**Who acts on it:** objectui triage → the Studio owner (the producer half). ⛔ Not a claim. Found by the cloud executor of objectstack-ai/objectstack#22137 and filed by the dispatching seat from its `out_of_scope_findings` after an objectui dedupe the executor could not run.

## What happens

The builder's two unary operators emit CEL that is only well-typed for a boolean field. CEL's `!` and a bare operand of `&&` take `bool`; a date, text or lookup field is not one, so the rule cannot be evaluated at runtime and the write is refused for a reason the author never sees. The builder offers no "is empty / is null" operator, so the only repair is to switch to Expression mode and type raw CEL (`record.due_date == null` fixed it).

## Where it comes from (read in source)

`ConditionBuilder` (`app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/ConditionBuilder.tsx`) maps op `truthy` to the bare subject and op `falsy` to `!` + subject, at the objectui pin `a58626c8` and unchanged on `main` `82500a7`.

## Expected

The builder emits type-correct CEL for the field it is given: for a non-boolean field "is empty" compiles to `== null` (plus the empty-string arm where the platform's is-empty semantics include it) and "is set" to `!= null`; `!` and the bare form only for a boolean field. Better still, the operator list follows the field type.

## Related

- objectstack-ai/objectstack#22032 (open) — the server half of the same failure: the save/publish door gives no verdict on validation conditions, so this rule published 200 and failed only at runtime.

## Environment

Studio task benchmark baseline run, 2026-10-08: objectstack `8fc50b76`, objectui `a58626c8` (console built at the `.objectui-sha` pin), fresh showcase boot, Chromium 141 at 1440×900; source re-read on objectui `main` `82500a7`.

## Duplicate check

- Semantic issue search on objectstack-ai/objectui (open and closed), *condition builder is empty false operator compiles to negation CEL no such overload on non-boolean field*: 1 hit (closed, objectstack-ai/objectui#8452 — `not_contains` on non-string values, a different operator and layer).
- Semantic issue search on objectstack-ai/objectui (open and closed), *ConditionBuilder falsy truthy operator emits bare field or !field validation rule unevaluable*: 9 hits, all closed and about other predicate surfaces (scope linting, boolean cell rendering, permissive fallbacks) — none about the emitted CEL.
- The executor's objectstack search found objectstack-ai/objectstack#22032 (related above).
